capabilities.notes: A headless agy session quoted the first heading of the live file, so the product loads it. The destination is shared with operator-owned sections, so registration refuses to replace a differing file instead of overwriting it.

agy plugin validate reported '28 processed' for this layout, and a headless agy session named three real skill folders while running from a directory with no .agents folder, so the global install is active on its own.
agy plugin validate reported '7 processed' and agy agents listed all seven role names from outside any workspace that carries its own copy.

install accepts a plain local directory; unlike codex plugin add it does not clone the source with git. The installed copy does not follow later renders, so re-running install is required after every package update.
Read from agy plugin --help on 1.2.7. plugin validate reports the processed count for skills, agents, commands, mcpServers, and hooks; a rules folder is not a processed component.
Pointing agy plugin validate at a package whose manifest sits in .claude-plugin/ fails with 'missing plugin.json', so the manifest must be at the root.
agy models listed the slug. Selection is manual through --model or /model.
agy --help documents --effort low|medium|high. No higher level is documented.

INFERRED, not re-verified. The event list and the absence of SessionStart come from the removed agy adapter's 2026-08-31 record for agy 1.1.22. agy 1.2.7 publishes no hook documentation through its CLI, so the list could not be re-checked. Because no event can be named with current evidence, this adapter renders no hook files and the routing contract is inlined into GEMINI.md instead.

A statusLine key exists in the settings file, but the removed adapters pointed it at a plugin path the product never creates and the dead entry had to be removed by hand on 2026-09-19. No status line is rendered until a working command is observed.
